stories.title: North Wales public protection report shows rise in recalls and registered sex offenders
stories.summary: The number of sex offenders and violent offenders in North Wales sent back to prison for breaching their licence has risen for the second year in a row. stories.title: Man jailed for three years after driving stolen taxi the wrong way on the A55
stories.summary: A man who stole a taxi in Holyhead, seriously injured a cyclist and then drove the wrong way along the A55 has been jailed for three years. Darragh O’Grady, 31, was sentenced at Caernarfon Crown Court today, Tuesday 10 November. stories.title: Formal objections open on plan to merge Catholic schools in Mold, Flint and Saltney
